svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.18.6.2 Ground Cover in Heated Crawl Spaces
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.18 CRAWL SPACES
Ground Cover in Heated Crawl Spaces
WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Where a crawl space is heated, a ground cover
of not less than 0.15 mm (5.9 mil)
polyethylene sheet conforming to
CAN/CGSB-51.34-M is installed as part of an
air barrier system in accordance with
Subsection 9.25.3.
Joints are lapped not less than 300 mm (11
13/16″), and the ground cover is
(a) sealed and evenly weighted down, or (b)
covered with concrete not less than 50 mm (1
The perimeter of the ground cover is sealed to
the foundation wall.
All penetrations of the ground cover are
sealed against air leakage.
Drawn: thickness exaggerated, sealant dark grey, hidden lap edge dashed, wall insulation not shown, concrete cut back in B.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.18.6.2. (page 9-135)
